summary: postinstall exfiltrates local data.txt contents to hardcoded ngrok endpoint
details: The package tarball contains only a package.json with a postinstall lifecycle hook and no library code, main, or bin. On `npm install`, the postinstall script runs a node one-liner that reads `data.txt` from the installer's working directory, parses JSON lines to extract AWS CloudWatch LogOptions fields (`awslogs-group`, `awslogs-stream`), and pipes the result via `curl -X POST` to the hardcoded ngrok tunnel `https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev`. The destination is an anonymous ngrok-hosted endpoint the installer did not configure, and the package ships no functionality other than this exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
